task: Transcribe this Hindi voice note and give me English subtitles
answer_en: I have transcribed the Hindi voice note and generated English subtitles for it. The transcript is provided in a text file, and the subtitles are in SRT format.

artifacts.description: Hindi transcript of the audio note (plain text).
English subtitles (SRT) for the audio note.

assumptions: The audio is in Hindi (language code hi).
English subtitles should be provided in .srt format.
English subtitles are required in .srt format.
notes: Rough cost to process every input once with its main model: Rs 0.16 (budget Rs 20.00).

assumptions: The audio is in Hindi (language code hi).
English subtitles should be provided in .srt format.
steps: transcribe_audio (language='hi', for_subtitles=true) to get Hindi transcript and segments JSON.
translate_text (input_path=segments JSON, target_language='en') to get translated segments JSON.
make_subtitles (segments_path=translated segments JSON) to produce English .srt subtitles.
plan.understanding: The user wants the Hindi audio note transcribed and English subtitles generated.
